reading.product_and_scene: Product: Neuro Energy & Focus, Extra Strength 9-piece carton, Peppermint, a light blue box with a Neuro logo and 'Energy & Focus' on its front. In the RIGHT frame it is a thin, flat carton on a wooden desk among the keyboard, mouse and power bank, and it looks small. In the WRONG frame it sits on a dark mouse pad beside a plush bunny and a keyboard, and it looks like a deeper, thicker block. Scene: an office desk. RIGHT frame: a man at a desk, seen from the side at desk height. WRONG frame: a woman lying at a keyboard with a POV text overlay, shot from close and low. Camera: handheld in both frames, with different angles and framing.
